text.name: Police stunned with their own flashbang!
text.text:
flashbang.mp3

The video starts with a man running away from three police.  One of them catches up to him and pushes him to the ground.  As the other two catch up they begin kicking and beating him with batons.  Suddenly a blinding flash of light and sound erupt right near the victims hands and the police are stunned.  The man gets up and runs away.

You watch it a couple of times and can't see any flashbang grenade before the explosion.

text.name: Magic Trick
text.text:
nowyouseeme.mp3

Footage from what looks like a lab with a person trapped in a clear glass box.  The scientist drones on 'Experiment 65: Escape from a sealed enclosure'.  When the scientist says 'Begin' the subject inside the glass enclosure gets a very focused look on their face.  It gets more strenous for ten seconds and then the subject starts to take a step directly into the glass, vanishing before they bump into it.  Almost instantaneosly reappearing about six feet outside of the enclosure.

text.name: Arson Girl
text.text:
arsongirl.mp3

Incredibly this is footage of the Cataclysm during the height of the portal storms.  It looks like Bar Harbor, Maine.  Some kind of godzilla sized squid lashes the docks with tentacles hundreds of feet long, while a Heritage class Coast Guard cutter fires its 57mm naval gun at the giant squid.

That is the background of the footage.  The foreground is at the top of the hill overlooking the road down to the docks.  Here people have taken shelter in stores on the main road down to the docks, but a young girl with bloodshot eyes giggles as she walks towards a storefront.  Her clothes are singed and the air around them shimmers like a summer heat haze.  Suddenly she squeals in delight as flames erupt from her arms and engulf the storefront.  She moves from one store to the next working her way down to the chaos of the docks, driving fleeing civilians from their shelter or melting the flesh from their bones when they move too slowly.
